demonstrates: Built a 2,627-item extraction instrument and established its floor before reading any result, then ran a seven-arm ablation that found one published corpus intervention inert under every condition its source specifies, caught and retracted a statistical error in my own analysis, and surfaced a training-service defect while writing the controls.
